And the last token I want to talk about today is $BTC
It's been a while since I've seen a memecoin attract this much attention, especially considering how weak Solana volume has been lately
$BTC launched on Pump.fun around mid-September and has been around for over a month. After staying relatively quiet for weeks, it suddenly exploded, gaining roughly 400–600% in 24 hours across different snapshots and reaching an ATH of nearly $24.5M market cap
When I last checked, it was trading around $18–19M MC, with over 12,000 holders and millions in daily volume, even exceeding $10M at certain points
But the chart isn't the only thing that caught my attention. I think there's a pretty interesting story behind this move

This is probably the first thing that got me interested in $BTC
Instead of being just another memecoin driven entirely by attention, the project combines meme culture with a holder rewards mechanism paid in Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC)
According to the project's information, $BTC has a liquidity pair with WBTC and distributes creator fees to eligible holders
More specifically, the project states that its 3% creator fee is allocated entirely to holder rewards. Anyone holding around $20 worth of $BTC can qualify to receive WBTC directly in their wallet without staking
Hold Big Titty Coin, earn Bitcoin rewards
I actually like this narrative. It's simple, easy to understand, and more importantly, extremely easy to spread across CT
Instead of receiving more of the same memecoin they're holding, holders receive WBTC. That gives people another reason to hold beyond simply expecting the token price to increase
Of course, rewards depend on actual trading activity and fees generated. This isn't guaranteed passive income or a fixed yield
One thing I'd still like to see is more transparency around the total WBTC distributed, the number of holders actually receiving rewards, and the average payout
If the project can maintain trading activity and provide clearer data on these metrics, I think this could become a pretty interesting narrative on Solana
2. @slingoorio – The Biggest Catalyst Behind $BTC
And of course, we can't talk about $BTC without mentioning slingoor
Massive shoutout to @slingoorio. This guy has been grinding insanely hard
Based on the information I've been following, slingoor currently controls around 57% of $BTC's total supply
That's a massive bag, and it shows just how much exposure he has to this project
But what I respect even more is how he's using his influence to build the community
He's constantly pushing $BTC on X, supporting related tokens, building the Titty Cabal, and organizing giveaways and airdrops to keep the community engaged
Slingoor is also no stranger to the Solana trenches. He's previously been associated with narratives like $TITCOIN, $USDUC, $LMAO, and $BODEN, and has experience within the Pump.fun ecosystem
With over 100K followers on X, he clearly has a strong advantage when it comes to attracting attention
Another thing that's been circulating heavily on CT is a screenshot of slingoor's Pump.fun portfolio
According to that snapshot, his portfolio reached approximately $23.06M, gaining nearly $18.88M in a single day, or more than 452%
Most of those gains were unrealized
I wouldn't use someone's portfolio value as a reason to buy a token, but it does show just how much exposure slingoor has to the narrative he's building
And looking at everything he's been doing lately, I'm leaning toward the idea that he wants to take $BTC much further than just another short-term pump
3. Titty Cabal – An Ecosystem in the Making?
This is probably what makes me the most bullish after the WBTC rewards mechanism
Slingoor isn't just promoting a single token. He's trying to build an entire mini ecosystem around $BTC, which the community calls the Titty Cabal
Several other tokens have started creating liquidity pairs with $BTC, including names like Little Titty and Extra Thick Hoe
Based on what's been shared, the number of related pairs has reportedly approached 200
In theory, this creates a pretty interesting flywheel :
More pairs => More trading activity => More fees => More holder rewards => More attention
If these related tokens continue attracting traders, $BTC could benefit from becoming a central trading asset within this ecosystem
Of course, not all volume generated by these pairs automatically translates into rewards for $BTC holders. That depends on the actual fee structure and distribution mechanisms
Still, I like the direction they're taking
Memecoins usually lose attention very quickly after a major pump, while communities that constantly create new activities have a better chance of keeping people interested
And that's exactly what slingoor seems to be trying to achieve with the Titty Cabal
4. Slingoor Reminds Me of What Ansem Did With $ANSEM
Looking at how slingoor has been operating lately, I honestly see quite a few similarities with $ANSEM back in the day
If you remember, $ANSEM didn't attract attention solely because of Ansem's name
What made that narrative interesting was how Ansem used his influence to support the community, promote the token, encourage airdrops, and help develop ideas around the ecosystem
Those efforts gave the community more reasons to stay involved instead of focusing entirely on the chart
And I'm seeing a pretty similar approach from slingoor
He's not just posting about $BTC every day. He's actively supporting related token pairs, growing the community, organizing giveaways, and creating more opportunities for holders to participate
To me, that's far more interesting than simply knowing he controls 57% of the supply
A KOL can create FOMO in a matter of hours, but building a community that can sustain attention over time is a completely different game
That's what I appreciated about Ansem's involvement with $ANSEM, and I'm seeing a similar level of energy from slingoor right now
Obviously, these aren't identical projects, and $ANSEM's success doesn't guarantee $BTC will follow the same path
But if slingoor keeps up this level of activity, I think $BTC has a real opportunity to develop into a much bigger narrative rather than just another memecoin that pumps for a few days
5. On-Chain and Holder Conviction
Coming back to the on-chain side for a moment
Based on the data I've reviewed, slingoor controls approximately 57% of the supply, while the top 10 holders account for around 67–68%
I find this holder structure particularly interesting
Slingoor has massive exposure to $BTC, and at the same time, he's putting considerable time and effort into growing the ecosystem around it
When I put those two things together, I'm leaning toward the idea that he's interested in building something longer-term
Especially when I compare his approach to how Ansem supported $ANSEM, I think having an influential figure with a substantial position who is also actively building the community can create strong conviction among followers
That said, I still separate conviction from what can actually be verified on-chain. Nobody can guarantee what any holder will decide to do with their tokens in the future
What I'll continue monitoring is wallet activity, holder growth, and the actual amount of WBTC being distributed
If those metrics keep developing positively, my bullish thesis on $BTC will have even more support
6. Catalysts I'm Watching Next
I think $BTC still has several catalysts that could help maintain its momentum
First, slingoor himself. He's still the biggest attention driver. If he continues actively building the community and supporting related projects, $BTC could remain a major topic across CT
Second, the Titty Cabal. Expanding liquidity pairs and bringing in more communities could generate additional trading activity around $BTC
Third, WBTC rewards. If volume remains healthy and the amount of rewards distributed continues growing, the "Hold $BTC, Stack Bitcoin" narrative could become even more attractive
Fourth, community activities. Airdrops, giveaways, and holder-focused campaigns could continue attracting new participants
And finally, there's the $100M market cap target that slingoor and the community have been talking about
I'm not going to pretend that's a guaranteed target, but from a memecoin perspective, when a token has strong attention, a simple narrative, and an active community, I can understand why people are setting ambitious expectations
Of course, reaching that valuation would still require significant capital inflows and sustained momentum after this massive run
7. My Personal Take and Trading Plan
Personally, I'm pretty bullish on $BTC from a narrative perspective
I like how the project combines memecoin culture with WBTC rewards, I like the idea behind the Titty Cabal, and most importantly, I respect what slingoor has been doing for the community
What gives me conviction isn't simply that a KOL holds a massive percentage of the supply
It's the fact that he's constantly creating new activities and giving the community more reasons to stay interested in the token
However, after a 400–600% pump in 24 hours, I'm definitely not interested in FOMO into green candles
From its ATH near $24.5M, $BTC has pulled back toward the $18–19M range. I'll be watching how price reacts around this area and would rather wait for a deeper dip with a better risk/reward setup
If volume remains healthy, holders continue growing, and the Titty Cabal keeps expanding with real activity, I think $BTC still has plenty of potential to attract more attention
On the other hand, if attention starts fading or selling pressure increases, a deeper correction is entirely possible after such an aggressive move
I'm still bullish on the overall narrative, but I'll be patient with my entry
And finally, once again, massive shoutout to @slingoorio
Really respect what you've been doing with $BTC, bro
From building the Titty Cabal and supporting holders to constantly pushing the narrative, the amount of effort you've put into this community is genuinely impressive
It reminds me of the energy Ansem brought to $ANSEM
Keep grinding, legend. Excited to see what comes next
